clip_rule: one complete intervention and observable target state change per clip
static_context: retain informative initial and final state; 2-3 seconds static in a 6-second clip may be acceptable
split_rule: split mirror directions and reset independent events, not short pauses inside a continuous event
exclude_rule: exclude camera-only movement and prolonged unrelated footage; do not pad to five seconds
count_rule: report proposals, exported clips, and human-approved valid clips separately
